features.name: Forward flushing
features.description: Automatic consumption of components once a production order is released. Designed for predictable components that do not require manual journal entry from the operator.
features.status_evidence_quote: Forward is for predictable components. Once the order is released, Business Central can consume them automatically

features.name: Backward flushing
features.description: Automatic consumption posted later when output is recorded or when the production order is finished. Waits for proof that work actually happened before posting.

features.name: Manual flushing
features.description: Operator reviews the component line and posts the actual consumption in the journal. Useful when quantities can vary or when the business wants tighter control.

features.name: Pick plus
features.description: A warehouse step that adds picking before the selected flushing rule applies. Does not replace forward, manual, or backward flushing, only adds the warehouse picking step.
caveats: pick plus only adds to the warehouse workflow; it does not replace the base flushing method

features.name: Routing link codes on components
features.description: A code on production order components that ties material consumption to a specific routing operation rather than treating the entire order as one timing event. Matching codes link components to their anchor operations.
caveats: routing link codes are optional; a blank routing link code applies timing to the order more generally

features.name: Component-level flushing policies
features.description: Each component line on a production order can carry its own flushing method instead of using one posting rule for the entire order. Allows mixing of forward, backward, manual, and pick plus on different components.

quotes.text: A flushing method defines when the system posts production activity automatically.
quotes.why_it_matters: Core definition of flushing and its purpose in the manufacturing workflow.

quotes.text: On a production order, each component line can carry its own posting rule.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that flushing methods are flexible at the component level, not fixed at the order level.

quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the role of pick plus as an additive warehouse step, not a replacement for flushing methods.
